title: SQL: Hospital performance and medication-order reconciliation
scenario: The analytics manager needs a department report for the last 90 days. Encounter and medication-order extracts are supplied separately. Several medication orders reference encounter IDs absent from the encounter file.
tasks: Inspect schema and state grain and primary key for each table.
Calculate encounter counts and mean length of stay by department.
Calculate medication-order line counts, quantities and extended cost by drug class.
Identify orphan medication orders and report their count and value.
Produce a department-level joined summary without encounter/order fan-out.
Document date-window, cancelled/discontinued order and readmission-flag assumptions.
deliverables: SQL file with at least five queries
QA note with row counts, unique keys, orphan count and join validation
critical_failures: Joining raw order lines to encounters and reporting duplicated encounter counts
Calling the supplied readmission flag a validated readmission rate without defining its construction

title: Python: Data-quality investigation and reproducible pipeline
scenario: A client provides three CSV extracts. Build a repeatable profiling script that validates keys, dates, categories, ranges and referential integrity. Do not mutate raw files.
tasks: Load inputs with explicit data types and parse dates.
Report row counts, unique keys, missingness and category frequencies.
Detect negative length of stay, invalid encounter references and unexpected categories.
Export an issue table with source row, rule, severity and proposed disposition.
Write a JSON QA summary and exit non-zero when critical checks fail.
Make execution independent of current working directory.
deliverables: README with run instructions and known limitations
critical_failures: Dropping invalid records without a quarantine or issue log
Reporting success when a configured critical integrity check fails

title: Excel: KPI reconciliation and management pack
scenario: A department head has an Excel workbook with encounter and order extracts. Produce a one-page summary that another analyst can audit.
tasks: Create a data dictionary and KPI definition table.
Use PivotTables or formula-based summaries for encounter count, mean LOS, order lines, quantity and extended cost.
Use a lookup/reconciliation method to flag orphan orders.
Apply data validation and conditional formatting to highlight exceptions.
Reconcile workbook totals to an independent SQL or Python result.
deliverables: Workbook with raw, cleaned/derived, KPI and QA sheets
critical_failures: Hard-coded headline metrics without traceable formulas
No clear definition of denominator or order status inclusion

title: Healthcare dashboard: executive review
scenario: A hospital operations leader wants a concise dashboard for department activity and pharmacy utilisation.
tasks: Define audience, decision and KPI dictionary before charting.
Design a two-page dashboard or equivalent report with clear titles, units, date range and data freshness.
Show department activity and medication-order class mix without implying orders were administered.
Display quality caveats and orphan-order impact.
Write three evidence-proportionate recommendations.

title: Remote client: clarify, negotiate and deliver
scenario: A client asks for a readmission dashboard by tomorrow. The readmission field is undocumented, source refresh time is missing, and orphan order references are present. A senior analyst is unavailable.
tasks: Write concise clarification questions that prioritise definition, population, time window and intended decision.
Propose a safe interim deliverable and explicitly label provisional measures.
State what cannot be validated before release and the risk of publishing.
Send a progress update and final handoff note with next actions.
critical_failures: Presenting an unvalidated metric as definitive
Failing to disclose the known data limitations
